description: This file defines the PlatformFontResolverInfo class within the PdfSharp.Fonts namespace, representing platform-specific font resolver information for GDI+ and WPF, including properties for platform-specific font objects.

classes.name: PlatformFontResolverInfo
classes.description: Represents platform-specific font resolver information, with conditional properties and constructors based on the compilation environment (GDI, WPF, etc.).

methods.name: PlatformFontResolverInfo
methods.description: Constructors for PlatformFontResolverInfo, differing by platform (GDI, WPF, CORE, WUI), initializing platform-specific font objects.
